title: In Search of the Ancient Polynesian Voyaging Canoe
version: Designer’s retrospective account archived by Polynesian Voyaging Society.
lineage: Relevant design section and its framing inspected anew. Participant account of design choices, not validation that feature distribution proves antiquity. Ancient migration dates, universal design ancestry and performance-equivalence claims are excluded. Overlaps PVS and Low’s interviews.

passages.quote: These I applied to the conceptual design.
passages.note: Kāne explicitly says his and Emory’s selection of widespread historically recorded features informed the new design.
